rules.name: recon-trades-04-consumer-joins-cfs
rules.sql: WITH s AS ( SELECT DISTINCT x.trade_id::text AS raw_id, CASE WHEN x.trade_id::text LIKE '%-' || CAST(:bu AS text) THEN left(x.trade_id::text, length(x.trade_id::text) - length(CAST(:bu AS text)) - 1) ELSE x.trade_id::text END AS stripped_id FROM opera.helper_settle_p_and_g_view_cache_table x WHERE x.tenant_id = :tenant AND x.business_unit = :bu AND x.settlement_date = (SELECT max(p0.settlement_date) FROM opera.recon_snapshot_pointer p0 WHERE p0.tenant_id = :tenant AND p0.business_unit = :bu AND p0.view_type = 'SETTLE_PRICING') ), c0 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT x.trade_id::text AS trade_id FROM opera.fx_nc_factor_view x WHERE x.tenant_id = :tenant AND x.business_unit = :bu ), c1 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT x.trade_id::text AS trade_id FROM opera.rms_premium_paid_table x WHERE x.tenant_id = :tenant AND x.business_unit = :bu ), c2 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT x.trade_id::text AS trade_id FROM opera.helper_calculate_trade_price_yield_view x WHERE x.tenant_id = :tenant AND x.business_unit = :bu ), c3 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT x.trade_id::text AS trade_id FROM opera.deal_ticket_table_deal_status_view x WHERE x.tenant_id = :tenant AND x.business_unit = :bu ), c4 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT x.trade_id::text AS trade_id FROM opera.helper_netting_deal_ticket_table_fy_view x WHERE x.tenant_id = :tenant AND x.business_unit = :bu ), c5 AS ( SELECT DISTINCT x.trade_id::text AS trade_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table x WHERE x.tenant_id = :tenant AND x.business_unit = :bu ) SELECT 'fx_nc_factor_view' AS joined_source, 'helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view, helper_risk_office_otc_report_new' AS used_by, (SELECT count(*) FROM s) AS snapshot_trades, (SELECT count(*) FROM c0) AS source_trades, (SELECT count(*) FROM s JOIN c0 ON c0.trade_id = s.raw_id) AS matched_as_the_views_join, (SELECT count(*) FROM s JOIN c0 ON c0.trade_id = s.stripped_id) AS matched_after_suffix_removed UNION ALL SELECT 'rms_premium_paid_table' AS joined_source, 'helper_risk_office_otc_report_new' AS used_by, (SELECT count(*) FROM s) AS snapshot_trades, (SELECT count(*) FROM c1) AS source_trades, (SELECT count(*) FROM s JOIN c1 ON c1.trade_id = s.raw_id) AS matched_as_the_views_join, (SELECT count(*) FROM s JOIN c1 ON c1.trade_id = s.stripped_id) AS matched_after_suffix_removed UNION ALL SELECT 'helper_calculate_trade_price_yield_view' AS joined_source, 'helper_settle_pricing_subportfoliovalues_view, helper_risk_office_otc_report_new (RBA, RBC only)' AS used_by, (SELECT count(*) FROM s) AS snapshot_trades, (SELECT count(*) FROM c2) AS source_trades, (SELECT count(*) FROM s JOIN c2 ON c2.trade_id = s.raw_id) AS matched_as_the_views_join, (SELECT count(*) FROM s JOIN c2 ON c2.trade_id = s.stripped_id) AS matched_after_suffix_removed UNION ALL SELECT 'deal_ticket_table_deal_status_view' AS joined_source, 'helper_eod_monthend_report_view' AS used_by, (SELECT count(*) FROM s) AS snapshot_trades, (SELECT count(*) FROM c3) AS source_trades, (SELECT count(*) FROM s JOIN c3 ON c3.trade_id = s.raw_id) AS matched_as_the_views_join, (SELECT count(*) FROM s JOIN c3 ON c3.trade_id = s.stripped_id) AS matched_after_suffix_removed UNION ALL SELECT 'helper_netting_deal_ticket_table_fy_view' AS joined_source, 'helper_eod_monthend_report_view' AS used_by, (SELECT count(*) FROM s) AS snapshot_trades, (SELECT count(*) FROM c4) AS source_trades, (SELECT count(*) FROM s JOIN c4 ON c4.trade_id = s.raw_id) AS matched_as_the_views_join, (SELECT count(*) FROM s JOIN c4 ON c4.trade_id = s.stripped_id) AS matched_after_suffix_removed UNION ALL SELECT 'cloned_deal_ticket_table' AS joined_source, 'control: the deal ticket itself, bare trade_id' AS used_by, (SELECT count(*) FROM s) AS snapshot_trades, (SELECT count(*) FROM c5) AS source_trades, (SELECT count(*) FROM s JOIN c5 ON c5.trade_id = s.raw_id) AS matched_as_the_views_join, (SELECT count(*) FROM s JOIN c5 ON c5.trade_id = s.stripped_id) AS matched_after_suffix_removed

expect.reason: every consumer join finds the same trades with and without the BU suffix: no view loses columns because of the suffix
